### 1. What the user expresses; simulator behaviour

He opens with: "My physical therapy approval runs out October 4th and I still need more physical therapy visits after that. Can you get that set up for me?" The target is his PT approval ending 10-04, and the action is an extension. He does not mention the move or any clinic "unless the agent asks where you get therapy now or who will do the extra visits". If asked, he names Salt Creek Rehabilitation (in network, per the clinic) with NPI 1386021457, says his last Riverbend visit was 09-22, and says he is not going back to Capitol Manual Therapy (last visit late August, ride booked for 09-29). He agrees to closing out Capitol and to moving the approval to Salt Creek. He files a member tool handed to him "with exactly what the agent gives you" and accepts any quoted figures. Identity: phone volunteered, and the other attributes are given on request (customer 3aed02ca-…).

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse

Act now. The PT approval is `approved` and ends 2026-10-04, which has not passed, so the late grace is irrelevant. It has no extension grant yet and the Outpatient Rehabilitation Therapy class allows 2 (`doc_auth_extension_terms_c332840c`: allowed Yes, 2 extensions, allotment 12, 60 days, grace 3), so `doc_auth_extension_rules_7b00f487` accepts an extension. Capitol's approval is approved and not past its end date, the member says the service will not be used, and the class releases units on a void, so a void applies (`doc_auth_void_release_dbf84de4`, `doc_auth_provider_change_void_settings_7e7e5a83`). The class allows a change of servicing provider to an in-network provider on an approved authorization (`doc_auth_servicing_provider_change_2fdd1ed0`). The member says Salt Creek is in network, and no record contradicts him.

### 6. Problem tree from the visible materials alone

Root: record the extension on A (agent tool).
- **Hop 1 — waits on the member's extension request (state-derived).** `doc_auth_extension_grant_92780551`: "The units an extension adds are fixed only after the authorization carries the member's extension request stating the additional units asked for." find_auth_actions on A shows only an approval notice. Searching "extension request" reaches `doc_auth_member_extension_request_c4808b6a` (member tool `file_extension_request_1d826295`).
- **Hop 2 — waits on the servicing provider being the in-network provider who will deliver the units (state-derived).** The extension-grant hub says: "The units an extension adds are not worked out before the authorization names, as its servicing provider, the in-network provider who will deliver them." The request hub's clause 3 carries the same state: "worked out only once the authorization names, as its servicing provider, the provider who will deliver the extended units". A names 1558203371 (Riverbend). Checking the state means asking who delivers, and the member answers Salt Creek. Searching "servicing provider" reaches `doc_auth_servicing_provider_change_2fdd1ed0` / `doc_auth_provider_change_carryover_d00ad751` (`change_servicing_provider_0d360835`). This hop applies both to the root and to hop 1.
- **Hop 3 — waits on no other overlapping approval of the same class/discipline standing approved (state-derived).** The hub says: "The units an extension adds are not recorded until no other approval of the member in the same class and, for therapy, the same therapy discipline stands approved over dates that overlap the period the extension adds." B (ORT, physical_therapy, approved through 10-24) overlaps 10-05..12-03. What moves B out of `approved`: B's end date has not passed, so an expiry release does not apply (`doc_auth_void_release_dbf84de4`: "A void applies only to an approval whose end date has not yet passed"), and withdrawal is for undecided requests only (`doc_auth_void_and_withdrawal_c12fdfdb`). A void does apply, because the member says the service will not be used. That points to `void_authorization_7849b1e5`.
- Leaves: the void and the provider change carry no prerequisite sentence.
Order: {void B, change provider on A} → member files the request → record the extension. No hop was pre-solved by a tool name, a route or a chain.

### Two-way counter-proof

- "Do only the extension": A carries no extension request, names Riverbend and not the provider who will deliver, and B overlaps. All three sentences block recording.
- "Hand over the request before the provider change" is blocked by the request hub's clause 3.
- "Expiry release of B" does not work because B's end date is 10-24, which has not passed. "Withdraw B" does not work because B is decided.
- The closest wrong numbers are the fall-backs: void 5, carry 3, request 22 (or 21 with carry 3), added 12. The blind answers are 1, 2, 25 and 11.
- Findability: each factor was reached from record words. Ride bookings, late pickups and no-shows are in find_ride_trips, `care_plan_update` and `care_contact` in find_care_activities, and `referral_type: standing` and `referral_visits` in find_pcp_events. Claims with `denied`/`no_prior_authorization`, and paid `specialist_visit` claims without a posted use, come from find_plan_claims. The Quality of Care Grievance, risk_score, variant ABD Care, the ledger uses and the grants complete the list. No computation document signalled a variation.
- Open points: (i) the meaning of `no_show_party: provider` (read as the ride provider). (ii) Whether the annual limit applies at extension recording. It does not bind at 11 here, but a larger factor sum would have been capped at 11.
